name: azure-oracle
description: Expert knowledge for Azure Oracle development including troubleshooting, security, and integrations & coding patterns. Use when configuring Oracle TDE with Azure Key Vault, Exadata log export, Azure Monitor, Sentinel, or PPGs, and other Azure Oracle related development tasks. Not for Azure SQL Database (use azure-sql-database), Azure SQL Managed Instance (use azure-sql-managed-instance), SQL Server on Azure Virtual Machines (use azure-sql-virtual-machines), SAP HANA on Azure Large Instances (use azure-sap).
